metadata.method: Fresh isolated emulator for each native boot; original and v9; PAL 800XL 64K stock. Same frozen menu-frame schedule as NTSC (3000..3599), 170 video frames warmup, centered joystick. B516 image intervals until first completed image after 15/30/60 seconds, or natural flight end. No state transfer, no memory patches. Four processes; balanced blocks of five per version.
metadata.natural_flight_end_rule: Retain shortened flights; count complete image intervals before leaving flight mode.
metadata.size_basis: 155 per version fixed before PAL measurement to repeat the NTSC protocol; no separate PAL pilot.
